name: integrity-memory
description: Mandatory client-only Integrity admission, coordination and closure hooks for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Mandatory receipt-bound memory admission for client Codex
interface.longDescription: Binds each client Codex intent to exactly one model-owned canonical Integrity admission; keeps prompt state local and provisional until that admission validates, then registers the admitted machine/thread/turn in a signed coverage ledger, requires one terminal Seed-events or no-event receipt, archives never-admitted provisional generations without creating coverage debt, preserves cross-turn semantic checkpoint debt until a verified canonical event, preflights append arguments before consuming the one-shot attempt, keeps read-only memory usable when Seed append admission is unavailable, and keeps Memory provider authority separate from target-specific action authority.
defaultPrompt: Recover the relevant Integrity project concept and current evidence.
Check ownership and blast radius before continuing this task.
Show the current receipt-bound Integrity admission status.
